title: The Dravenhollow Question
description: The Dravenni situation has reached a breaking point. Whether they fight alongside Veltria or against it depends on every choice you have made about their people.

title: Budget Allocation — Dravenni Response
description: Whatever path you choose in Dravenhollow has a price tag. Autonomy means development funds. Suppression means military expenditure. Both are expensive in different currencies.

title: Military-Civilian Relations — Institutional Review
description: The war footing is straining the relationship between the general staff and the civilian government. Brenner has been professional. The question is what happens when professional isn't enough.

title: Border Incidents — Escalation Review
description: Three separate skirmishes in the Gravenmark Pass this week. Each one could be the pretext Vukov is waiting for. Dusek wants rules of engagement clarified before a lieutenant makes a decision that starts a war.

title: War Economy — Transition Planning
description: Vostane has completed the war economy transition framework. Rationing protocols, industrial conversion timelines, labor mobilization. She's asking you to approve what she hopes you never have to use.
